# Auto-Heal Tracking Directory

This directory stores tracking files for auto-heal workflow attempts.

Each file contains:
- Failed workflow details
- Error logs and analysis
- Instructions for GitHub Copilot agents
- Recommendations for fixes

## File Naming Convention

`[workflow-slug]-[timestamp].md`

Example: `ci-workflow-20240115-143000.md`

## Cleanup

Tracking files can be safely deleted after the corresponding auto-heal PR is merged or closed.

Recommended cleanup:
```bash
# Remove files older than 30 days
find .github/auto-heal-tracking/ -name "*.md" -mtime +30 -delete
```

## Do Not Manually Edit

These files are automatically generated by the auto-heal workflow.
Manual edits may be overwritten or cause issues with the auto-heal process.
